Ruling: model error; i1040gi p. 110, Part V caution: "Fill out Schedule 1-A, Part V, only if: • You (and/or your spouse if filing a joint return) were born before January 2, 1961. • You have a valid social security number (SSN)." The candidate's line 31 copies line 3 with no test of whether Part V is filled out, so it shows a nonzero amount on completed returns where the Part is not filled out. Under the adjudication README skip rule a line of a Part the instructions say not to fill out must not show an amount on a reachable return; the project enters zero there through its Part gate (s1a.part5 false), which changes no deduction but makes the candidate's shown amount a defect. Re-reviewed because the Part gates were rewritten (s1a.part2 and s1a.part3 a nested choose on the tips or overtime answer, then the filing status, then the SSN test; the Part V counts through person.senior_work_ssn), the same conjunctions in operand order, which change no completed value (BUG-0466/0471 follow-up, T-264); the reply is of the same kind as the one ruled before on this line, and the reading stands. executable-triage-v2 (.transcription/triage/2025/s1a.json; 1,747 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 114 partial records): 131 of 2,361 comparisons agree; differences {"candidate-refuses": 464, "candidate-unknown": 32, "project-unknown": 7, "value": 1727}; on completed returns {"value": 1073}.
